description.value: The Shed Eatery is the waterfront restaurant at Bowen Golf Club on Bowen Island, perched between the 1st and 9th holes with uninterrupted views of Seymour Bay, Howe Sound, and the North Shore Mountains. Established in 2020 and run by the team behind Mexican-ish, the kitchen makes over 80% of every dish in-house and pours hand-selected craft beers and wines from local BC vendors. Non-golfers are explicitly welcome, and the dog-friendly patio makes it a natural stop for cyclists who've made the scenic ferry crossing from Horseshoe Bay.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully corroborates the OSM record: phone +1 (604) 947-4653 matches OSM's +16049474653, the address 810 Beach Drive Bowen Island BC is confirmed on the contact page, and the restaurant is confirmed open daily with no golf membership required. Vegetarian and gluten-free options are explicitly named in the menu, and takeout is mentioned for pizza night. No mention of bike-specific infrastructure (racks, pump, charging) anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Vancouver' but the business is physically located on Bowen Island, BC — a separate municipality reached by ferry. May affect geographic filtering in the directory.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible restaurant on Bowen Island with confirmed hours and active upcoming events; no golf membership required to dine.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists 'Spring Chopped Salad Pie' labelled Vegetarian; pizza night offers 'Gluten-free & dairy-free options available.'
